claim: Patchline proves no live code reads a column before a migration is allowed to drop it, so a DROP COLUMN cannot remove data that an active code path still depends on. The worker collects every code symbol that reads each column and declares a column safe to drop only when its live-read set is empty, otherwise it returns the readers that keep the column alive. The gate proves a column with zero live reads is certified droppable and a column still read by active code is retained with its readers reported.
